subject: Cross-border data mapping & TIA request from MedPay Solutions
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medpay-solutions.eu>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: DPO Team <dpo@medpay-solutions.eu>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 13:14:00 +0200
Subject: Transfer impact information request / data mapping

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our security and privacy team would like to run a short transfer impact assessment for any data that would cross EEA borders if we were to integrate with Redwood.

Please could you provide the following by end of week: 
- Completed attached TIA questionnaire (medpay_tia_questions_v1.xlsx)
- A data flow map identifying where personal data is processed (controllers/processors/subprocessors, regions)
- List of data categories and retention periods for logs, telemetry and user content
- confirmation of legal bases and whether SCCs are used / where executed
- Any DPIA or high-level privacy impact notes you have for services handling health-adjacent data
- Redacted SOC 2 or equivalent evidence and the point of contact for compliance follow-ups

We have a tight procurement window and would appreciate anything you can share to help our DPO sign off.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Data Protection Officer
MedPay Solutions

[Attachment: medpay_tia_questions_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medpay-solutions.eu>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Transfer impact information request / data mapping

Elena — thanks for the clear list. I’ve looped in our Legal (Laura) and Security (Monica) teams so we can get you a consolidated package. We can provide: completed TIA questionnaire, a data-map template populated with redwood-hosted vs customer-only processing, redacted SOC2, and our standard SCCs.

A couple quick clarifying Qs to help prioritize:
- Are you primarily concerned about telemetry/logs (Pseudonymous) vs user-uploaded clinical notes (Sensitive)?
- Do you need evidence of key separation (KMS/HSM) or certs for specific cloud regions?

Targeting to get the first pass back by Friday EOD — does that work?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 10:33:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Transfer impact information request / data mapping

Rishi / Monica — forwarding Elena’s request. Draft plan below for what we can deliver this week and items that will need follow-up: 

Deliverables (this week):
- Completed medpay TIA questionnaire (we will populate fields with defaults and mark any customer-action items) — Attachment: redwood_data_map_template.xlsx (populated)
- Redacted SOC2 report: provide control narrative and redacted evidence (SOC2-Redacted-2026.pdf)
- Executed SCCs (copy): SCCs_signed_2025.pdf
- DPIA executive summary (DPIA-summary-2026.txt)

Follow-ups / need more info:
- Subprocessor list and regions: we will provide current list, but new subprocessors may be added quarterly — suggest a clause/notice plan
- Specific data categories for clinical uploads — if MedPay can flag which model calls are in-scope, we’ll mark them for additional controls (encryption-in-transit & at-rest, token redaction options)

Notes on technical controls:
- KV cache and model state: stored on ephemeral GPU-backed volumes in the region of execution; persistent logs and metrics are stored in encrypted object storage in the region selected by the customer.
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS1.2+ in transit; customers can bring their own KMS (BYOK) for Dedicated/Private deployments.

I’ve attached the artifacts we can share immediately. For anything that needs more redaction or legal review, I’ll coordinate with your DPO.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_data_map_template.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: SOC2-Redacted-2026.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: SCCs_signed_2025.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: DPIA-summary-2026.txt (txt)]

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medpay-solutions.eu>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Cc: DPO Team <dpo@medpay-solutions.eu>, marco.ferri@medpay-solutions.eu
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 09:20:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Transfer impact information request / data mapping

Laura — thank you, this is helpful. A couple of items for clarification: 
- Please confirm whether SCCs have been executed with your cloud provider (we require proof for processors).
- For the DPIA summary, can you specify any mitigations for inference-logging that could retain user text? Our risk team is specifically concerned about re-identification from logs.
- Also, does Redwood offer an on-prem / VPC private deployment option for customers who cannot accept cross-border processing?

If possible please mark the fields on the data map that are customer-action (e.g., retention settings we control) vs Redwood-managed defaults. 

Best regards,
Elena

[Attachment: medpay_review_notes.pdf (pdf)]

From: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medpay-solutions.eu>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 12:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Transfer impact information request / data mapping

Elena — quick responses inline: 
- SCCs: yes — we have executed SCCs with our primary cloud provider and will attach the signed copy (see SCCs_signed_2025.pdf). We’ll also include the subprocessors and locations with dates-of-execution.
- Logs/inference data: our default telemetry is pseudonymized and retention is 30 days; customer content is not stored for model training by default. For customers with higher sensitivity we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments and offer token redaction and prefix caching controls. Full DPIA notes attached; mitigation options include exfiltration monitoring, BYOK, and optional log scrubbing prior to storage.
- Private deployment: yes — Redwood Private (VPC or on‑prem bundle) is available; I’ve added a short product note in the Drive link. We’ll propose a follow-up call if you want a technical run-through.

Next steps: we’ll send the completed questionnaire and a populated data map by EOD Friday and set up a 30-minute call next week to walk the DPO through the artifacts.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: medpay_tia_questions_v1_completed.xlsx (xlsx)]
